newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 1.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 1.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Metway Bank Limited on 28/03/1997, from 9,744,186 ordinary shares (6.97%) to 9,728,173 ordinary shares (5.10%).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Amcor Limited on 17/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 32,979,382 ordinary shares (5.20%).

Hambros Hopkins Asset Management became a substantial shareholder in Techniche Limited on 27/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 1,458,718 ordinary shares (5.47%).
Hambros Hopkins Asset Management became a substantial shareholder in CSL Limited on 27/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,986,000 ordinary shares (5.37%).
Hambros Hopkins Asset Management Ltd increased its relevant interest in National Foods Limited on 03/03/1997, from 16,782,714 ordinary shares (6.20%) to 23,415,000 ordinary shares (8.65%).

Hambros Hopkins Asset Management became a substantial shareholder in Lang Corporation Limited on 27/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 7,588,602 ordinary shares (7.09%).
Ashton Mining Limited increased its relevant interest in Australian Diamond Exploration NL on 27/03/1997, from 43,082,289 ordinary shares ( %) to 43,982,623 ordinary shares (99.17%).
Mercury Asset Management Group ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Qantas Airways Limited on 21/03/1997.

Prudential Portfolio Managers Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Delta Gold NL on 25/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 11,274,025 ordinary shares (5.4848%).

Natwest Markets Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Skilled Engineering Limited on 25/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,861,355 ordinary shares (8.53%).

Optima Fund Managers Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Skilled Engineering Limited on 25/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,000,000 ordinary shares (7.28%).
Seaward Holdings Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Nexus Minerals NL on 21/03/1997.
Packer & Co Ltd increased its relevant interest in Dominion Mining Limited on 27/03/1997, from 6,221,503 ordinary shares (7.16%) to 7,092,717 ordinary shares (8.16%).
